$comment: The hand-written half of this project's manifest. Everything else -- the systems, their folders, extensions and browse mode, the firmware ABI, sizes and hashes -- is derived from the packed core by scripts/make_manifest.py. Nothing derivable belongs here.

description.en: The 8 KB ColecoVision boot ROM. ColecoVision games need it: the core reads it into a freshly allocated buffer at load time and has no fallback, so without it a game starts on uninitialised memory. Note the folder keys differ -- games live in roms/col/, this file in /bios/coleco/.
